features.name: Shape Self
features.description: As an action, you can reshape your body to a two-legged Humanoid shape or to a four-legged Beast shape. While you have a Humanoid shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

features.name: Delightful Imitator
features.description: You have proficiency in the Performance skill.

features.name: Unpredictable Movement
features.description: When you roll Initiative and don’t have Disadvantage on that roll, you can take the Dash action as a Reaction.
